---
name: Mathematical correction or reference
about: Report an error, a gap between a formal statement and its prose, an earlier source, or an unclear proof
title: "[ID] Short description"
labels: review
---

**Result identifier or Lean declaration**
For example ST-01, or NormalityChecker.StonehamPolynomial.prime_power_polynomial_normal. The identifiers are listed in docs/results.md.

**Affected artifact**
- [ ] statement in the README or the result index
- [ ] written proof in notes/
- [ ] manuscript in papers/ (which paper and section)
- [ ] Lean statement or definition

**Description**
The step, hypothesis or convention in question. If possible, a counterexample or the missing hypothesis.

**Literature (if applicable)**
Bibliographic details and the specific theorem, with its hypotheses.
